variations.cta: Try LumenKart — get it on Flipkart today

output.copywriting_notes: Sensitive-skin buyers on Flipkart are in discovery mode, so the urgent-energy tone is deployed through consequence framing (every harsh cleaner is a skin event waiting to happen) rather than countdown pressure. The eco angle (80% less plastic) is secondary reinforcement — the primary pain is skin, and the copy addresses that first to earn the sustainability message.
